nodes.title: Alphabet reduction with given constants

nodes.summary: Let $I = (n, \Sigma, C)$ be a 2CSP instance and $\sigma$ an assignment of a label less than $\Sigma$ to each variable less than $n$. A constraint $(u, v, P)$ is satisfied by $\sigma$ when $u < n$, $v < n$ and the pair $(\sigma(u), \sigma(v))$ belongs to $P$.
nodes.title: Satisfied constraint of a 2CSP instance

nodes.summary: For a 2CSP instance $(n, \Sigma, C)$ and a natural number $v$, the degree of $v$ is the number of entries $(u, w, P)$ of the list $C$ with $u = v$ or $w = v$.
nodes.title: Degree of a variable in a 2CSP instance

nodes.summary: Let $I = (n, \Sigma, C)$ be a 2CSP instance and $\sigma$ an assignment of a label less than $\Sigma$ to each variable less than $n$. The value of $I$ under $\sigma$ is the rational number $1$ if $C$ is empty, and otherwise the number of entries of the list $C$ that are constraints satisfied by $\sigma$, divided by the length of $C$.
nodes.title: Value of a 2CSP instance under an assignment

nodes.summary: A 2CSP instance is a triple $(n, \Sigma, C)$ of a natural number $n$ (the number of variables), a natural number $\Sigma$ (the alphabet size) and a finite list $C$ of constraints, where each constraint is a triple $(u, v, P)$ of natural numbers $u$ and $v$ (the variables it mentions) and a finite list $P$ of pairs of natural numbers (the allowed label pairs).
nodes.title: 2CSP instances

nodes.summary: A 2CSP instance $(n, \Sigma, C)$ is well-formed when every constraint $(u, v, P)$ in $C$ satisfies $u < n$ and $v < n$, and every allowed pair $(a, b)$ in $P$ satisfies $a < \Sigma$ and $b < \Sigma$.
nodes.title: Well-formed 2CSP instances

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
